content.text:
Excellent! The logs are very revealing. I can see the issue clearly:

1. The producer queue is 96% full
2. The brokers are heavily throttling the producer - with throttle times around 2.8-3.0 seconds
3. The consumer lag is growing (31.2 million+ messages behind)
4. The rate of messages consumed (40,000-41,000/min) is slightly less than what's coming in

This indicates that the Kafka brokers are rate-limiting the producer. Let me search the documentation to understand Kafka producer throttling and best practices:

input.query: Kafka producer throttling rate limiting broker
Kafka producer configuration batching compression performance
Kafka quota rate limiting producer throughput
